source_quotes: never pkill -f / pgrep -f own text (killed my shell 3 times)
overlap_check: method_16 (30016) covers host lifecycle; its R0 already covers not spawning host processes (not repeated). New otherwise.

payload.name: Control Processes by PID
payload.description: Processes are found and stopped by exact name or PID, never by matching text that also appears in the command that is searching, which can kill the shell itself.

principles.name: A search can match itself
principles.description: Matching on command text finds the searching shell too.

heuristics.condition: a shell dies right after a pkill or pgrep -f
heuristics.action: suspect a self-match before suspecting anything else

decision_rules.name: Match exact
decision_rules.outcome: use an exact-name match (pgrep -x) or a PID from a pid file, not -f with text that appears in the command

decision_rules.name: Kill by pid
decision_rules.outcome: kill the PID that was found and confirm it is the intended process first
